appearance.extreme: Their clothing is holed and yellowed wherever it touches them. The smell is eye-watering, and the floor where they stood is tacky.
appearance.obvious: Their clothes are eaten thin at the collar and armpits, and there's a sharp chemical smell about them.
appearance.subtle: Their collar is stained through in a way that doesn't look like ordinary sweat.

description: What comes off you isn't quite sweat any more. Nobody wants to hold onto you. Neither does your shirt.
drawbacks: People don't want to touch you
name: Acidic Sweat
